text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#89421. Trigger: CUDA vmem surge detected on pool eu-gpu-3 (auto-escalate)
pagerduty: page delivered to Alex (rotation)
Alex: acked. I'm on it :eyes:
Alex: initial symptom: repeated cudaMalloc/CUBLAS allocation failures across 4 nodes in eu-gpu-3
Alex: metrics snapshot — vmem % by node: eu-gpu-3-01=97%, 3-02=95%, 3-03=92%, 3-04=88% ; baseline ~60%
Jordan: digging logs now, past minute shows a big prefetch spike from kvcache prefetcher
Jordan: pasted tail of pod logs:
Jordan: ```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z model-worker[pid=4521]: prefetch: requested 3.2GB
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z model-worker[pid=4521]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (24)
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z kernel: [oom_reaper] kill process 4521 (python) score 987
```
Alex: looks like prefetch burst + large batch requests. Could be a bad client workload or a regression in kvcache prefetch config.
Priya: I'm taking next shift in 10m. Alex, any quick mitigation before handoff?
Alex: yes — immediate steps:
- disable kvcache prefetch for pool eu-gpu-3
- reroute new requests from pool eu-gpu-3 -> eu-gpu-fallback-small
- drain the worst node (eu-gpu-3-01) for manual eviction and restart
Alex: running command to toggle prefetch (experimental cli):
Alex: ```
rdwctl pool-config set eu-gpu-3 --kvcache-prefetch=false --apply-immediate
rdwctl route set --from=eu-gpu-3 --to=eu-gpu-fallback-small --mode=failover
``` 
Alex: issuing drain on eu-gpu-3-01: `kubectl annotate node eu-gpu-3-01 scheduling=drain && kubectl drain eu-gpu-3-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Mateo: I can force driver container restart on 3-01 if drain doesn't free memory quickly
Priya: acked handoff. I'm monitoring; will pick up in 10.
pagerduty: PD#89421 acknowledged by Alex at 2026-03-15T14:03:02Z
incident-bot: automated reroute triggered: 22% traffic moved off eu-gpu-3 to fallback (latency increase expected for some requests)
Elena (CS): CS ping — ticketing: some customers report higher latencies and 429s for embeddings. Not seeing errors in stored logs yet. Affected org: synth-health-prod has ~1% request drop for embeddings in EU region.
Alex: customer impact: increased 429s and tail latency for heavy-embedding routes; small subset of traffic (~2-3% overall) hit fallback which has smaller batch capacity; we'll honor SLA for critical traffic via reserved capacity if needed.
Jordan: quick check: rollout of kvcache change yesterday at 03:00 had a config bump to aggressive prefetch=2.5x for short context flows — reverting that now.
Alex: config change rollback applied, prefetch disabled. Watching vmem metrics...
(30s pass)
Alex: node eu-gpu-3-01 vmem dropped 97% -> 68% after drain + restart, cudaMalloc failures subsiding
Mateo: forced `driverd` restart on 3-01 completed; evictions reduced
Priya: traffic reroute steady. 5m latency percentile for fallback requests is +120ms vs normal, but error rate down to baseline.
Elena (CS): notifying Synth-Health: telling them we're mitigating, expect brief elevated latency window, will follow up with root cause.
Alex: noting runbook tasks: create follow-up ticket to audit prefetch rollout, add guardrail to prevent >50% simultaneous prefetch on a single pool, add alert to detect prefetch storm early.
Priya: taking it to postmortem. I'll own the ticket and draft RCA. Tagging Jordan and Mateo for infra fixes.
Alex: handing off fully to Priya — oncall transition :rotating_light: ; I'll stay available for questions.
Priya: thanks — I have PD escalation policy in place. If PD auto-escalates again, page rotation will send to SRE lead.
incident-bot: PD#89421 resolved by Priya at 2026-03-15T14:12:35Z (auto-resolve after ack + mitigation)
Alex: marking thread resolved in channel. Follow-ups: ticket INF-3921 (prefetch guardrail), ENG-ops checklist update.
Priya: closing loop with CS and scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Elena (CS): thanks team. I'll follow up with Synth-Health and update the incident timeline in the customer note.
Jordan: saving logs and metric snapshot to /incidents/89421/artifacts
Mateo: will propose kernel-level backstop for cuda alloc fallback next week.
Priya: final status: service degraded briefly, mitigation applied, customer impact limited to small latency/error bump for synth-health-prod, follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
